title: EmbeddingConfig
description: Embedding service configuration for semantic deduplication and similarity search (§6.10.1). Supports local transformer models, remote APIs, and caching.

adapter.description: Embedding adapter to use: 'local' (BGE-small transformer), 'remote' (Anthropic API), or 'cached' (local with caching). Hot-reloadable.

cache_enabled.description: Enable in-memory caching of embeddings keyed by content hash. Hot-reloadable.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Cache entry TTL in seconds (default: 24 hours). Expired entries are evicted on next access. Hot-reloadable.

rate_limit_rpm.description: Rate limit for remote embedding API calls in requests per minute. Null = no limit. Only applies to 'remote' adapter. Hot-reloadable.
